deepdive.sec: Affordable Housing Finance (NBFC-HFC) — rural / semi-urban, self-employed focus

bull_bear.body: Well-capitalized: net worth Rs.52.2 bn, CAR 44.66% (far above regulatory). Growth funded by internal accruals (NW compounding +16% YoY) + diversified borrowings (Rs.207 bn, longer-tenor than assets → positive ALM all buckets). No buyback/dividend commentary.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Spread compression below 5%** is management's own base case — execution on cost/income levers is the whole thesis; a miss flows straight to ROE.
- **Leadership/governance overhang:** MD (Manu Singh) appointment "subject to RBI approval"; Interim CFO.
- **RBI circular on asset classification of repossessed assets** — "under evaluation," potential NPA-recognition impact unquantified.
- Macro credit: proactive Feb policy tightening on segments exposed to West Asia/Middle East conflict + fuel crisis (tours & travels, restaurants) and expected rainfall shortfall.
- Elevated pre-payment/BT-out early in the quarter (normalized by June — watch for recurrence).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, execution-heavy, candid on trade-offs (openly accepts spread <5% and defends the HL-mix choice on 2-yr-CAGR pushback). Repeated "faster, fitter, more productive" framing; "people, performance, perseverance." Corrected an analyst who conflated the 20% medium-term figure with current-year guidance — precise rather than promotional.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The 41% disbursement growth is base-effect-aided; the real signal is **monthly AUM addition +50% YoY** and cost-to-income −254 bps — a genuine productivity step-up, not just rate tailwind.
- Deliberate margin give-up: choosing lower-yield HL over higher-yield NHL to rebuild HFC identity/share — a multi-year mix decision that pressures NIM near-term.
- Fast-repricing liability book (76%) means falling rates help CoF but also compress asset yields via PLR pass-through — spread, not NIM level, is the number to watch.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Capital structure as reported: Net Worth of Rs 52.2 bn and CRAR of 44.66% (the capital-ratios slide also shows CAR of 44.5%, 44.0%, 51.4%, 54.5%, 47.0% and values 44.6% / 44.7% across the FY21-Q1FY27 series, where the individual year-to-value binding is not reliably preserved).
- Return on Capital Invested (ROCI, annualized) is charted as 14%, 16%, 20%, 24%, 29%, 33%, 39%, 45%, 47% with the annotation "Without raising Capital", i.e. growth funded without fresh equity over the period shown.
- Leverage is modest and disclosed in the ROE tree as "Leverage (Avg Total Assets to Avg Net Worth) (x)" of 3.69, 3.83, 4.02, 4.25, 4.32 and 4.23 for FY21 to FY26.
- Liquidity is run with surplus: "Rs 32,320 Mn of Surplus Funds* available for business" (*without including any incremental sanctions), Total Liquidity Position of Rs 23,680 mn as on Jun-26 (Cash & Cash Equivalents 17,820; Un-availed CC Limits 1,010; Documented & Un-availed Sanctions from Banks 4,850), and "High-Quality Liquidity of Rs 18,830 Mn", with the ALM slide captioned "Greater Resilience across liquidity cycles" and showing a positive cumulative surplus in every bucket up to 5 years.
- The deck makes no mention of dividend, buyback or any capital raise.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Standalone HFC, no subsidiaries discussed. **HL** +38% YoY (17% volume growth); **NHL** (LAP/MSME) is the higher-yield leg — 150-200 bps above HL. Management is intentionally rotating acquisition effort back toward HL (direct sourcing, lower cost of acquisition) to correct a drift toward NHL over the past 1.5 years. Explicitly **no builder/developer loans** ("we do not do any builder loan kind of product").

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers (listed names)

business.body:
- The deck lists eight "Pillars of Strength": Diverse Geographical Distribution, In-house Execution Model, Diversified Customer Base, Professional Management Team, Experienced Board of Directors, Diversified Shareholding Base, Future ready Tech Platform and Strong Institutional Framework.
- Customer profile is deliberately granular and retail: "99.6% Retail Loans", "62% | 38% Self-Employed | Salaried", "83% <15 lakhs Ticket Size", "54% EWS & LIG" and "4,15,000+ Families Served", described as a "Granular portfolio construct driving superior asset quality".
- The "Right to Win with In-house Model" slide frames the moat as focused in-house sourcing plus "In-house & Mutually Exclusive Four Pillars Of Risk — 4 Pillars: Credit, Legal, Technical & RCU" and a "Four-tiered collection architecture", supported by Mitra/CSC, connector, channel-partner and digital channels.
- Portfolio mix at origination: AUM by Income Category EWS/LIG 54%, MIG 34%, HIG 12%; AUM by Ticket size (No of Loans) 83% up to Rs 1.5 mn; AUM by LTV (at Origination) 23% upto 40%, 37% >40% to 60%, 40% >60%.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Ownership] Shareholding as on 30 June 2026 shows CVC Capital at 48.88%, DII 22.15%, FII 16.27%, Management & Employees 1.05% and Others 11.65%; other named institutional holders include ICICI Pru AMC 3.80%, HDFC AMC 3.47%, Axis Max Life 3.15%, UTI AMC 3.07%, Sundaram AMC 2.52%, GPF Global 2.29%, Nippon AMC 2.19%, Vanguard Index Funds 2.15%, ADIA 2.13%, SBI AMC 2.01%, Whiteoak 1.46%, MIT (managed by 360 One AMC) 1.37% and Blackrock 1.26%.
- [Leadership transition] Manu Singh is shown as "MD* & Chief Executive Officer" with the footnote "* Subject to RBI Approval" and an Aavas tenor of "<1 Year"; the CFO (Ghanshyam Gupta) and CRO (Punit Agarwal) are both designated "Interim", and the board slide is titled "New Board bringing in a wealth of experience" with four Promoter Nominee Directors.
- [Asset quality track record] The asset-quality slide carries the claim "Lifetime write-off of 12 bps against lifetime disbursement of Rs. 425 bn"; GNPA is 1.11% and NNPA 0.71% for Q1FY27, with 1+DPD at 3.76% (commentary: GNPA "improved by 11 bps YoY", NNPA "by 13 bps YoY" and 1+DPD "improved by 39-bps YoY").
- [Assignment / off-book] Net Assignment Volume is charted at 5,496; 7,784; 9,541; 12,428; 15,226 and 16,771 (Rs mn) for FY21-FY26, and the P&L separately carries "Upfronting Income on Fresh Assigned Loans" and "Reversal Income on Earlier Assigned Loans" lines.
- [Rate pass-through] Yield footnotes flag "Impact of 15 bps reduction in PLR w.e.f. Mar-26" and "Impact of 10 bps reduction in PLR w.e.f. Jun-26"; the balance sheet is largely floating on both sides (84% Floating Rate Borrowings, 71% Floating Rate Assets).
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: NIM 7.70% (+22 bps) despite two PLR cuts (−10 bps in June, −25 bps cumulative since Mar-26 passed to customers), because CoF improved 38 bps YoY and disbursement yields were pushed to risk-adjusted pricing — portfolio yield and disbursement yield have now "come very close." 76% of borrowings re-price fast (42% external benchmark: Repo/T-Bill/MIBOR; 34% sub-3-month MCLR), a double-edge in a falling-rate world. Cost-to-income −254 bps is the standout, sourced from productivity not scale alone.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q1 FY27 (this):** Disb +41% (low base), AUM Rs.239.3 bn (+15.4%), PAT Rs.1.71 bn (+23%), NIM 7.70%, C/I 43.7% (−254 bps), GS3 1.11%, ROA 3.19%/ROE 13.34%, 440 branches. Guidance set: FY27 disb 22-23%, AUM 17-18%, medium-term AUM 20%, spread <5%, productivity/resource to double in 2 yrs.
- _Q2 FY27 → check: did spread actually break <5%? disbursement run-rate vs the 22-23% path; HL-share regain; RBI repossession-circular impact; CFO/MD confirmation (RBI approval); asset quality after monsoon._
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log (fill each quarter)

outlook.body:
- **Disbursement growth: 22-23% for FY27** (yearly "commitment"); **AUM growth 17-18% FY27**; **20% AUM growth sustainable over the medium term** (explicitly NOT the current-year number — mgmt corrected the analyst).
- **Spread: expected to fall "a tad below 5%"** over the remaining year (from 5.06%); ROA/ROE guided to hold at planned levels via cost + income levers even if slight compression occurs.
- **Productivity/resource: double from ~Rs.8-10 lakh to Rs.20-22 lakh per field resource — timeline shortened to 2 years** (from an implied 3).
- Asset quality: 1+DPD to stay comfortably below 5%; credit cost within guided range.
- Branch/mix: HL:NHL to stay ~65:35; regain HL share (17% HL volume growth in Q1 YoY already visible).
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)

outlook.body: Not an order-book business. Growth engine = branch productivity + customer acquisition. Branch network **440 across 15 states**; continued branch expansion with a focus on faster branch-level break-even. Disbursement run-rate re-based higher in Q1 to front-load P&L for the year ("more you upfront the business, more earnings across the year").
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- Direct-sourcing revival (lower CAC, better quality) as the lever to defend margin while growing HL.
- Data/tech for login→disbursement funnel conversion and underwriting.
- Operating leverage on a young branch cohort as new branches hit break-even.
